window: Data through late July 2026, printed on the August board
lead: Cash is still parked. Money-market funds hit a record on this print, then eased and stayed elevated. Gold ETFs were an outflow in June. Bitcoin ETFs were a small net outflow for July. Ether ETFs out-drew them. That is not a settled liquidity clock, and it is not a new ticket. Paper stays hold.
timeline: The liquidity timeline did not load on this snapshot. No chart is invented in its place.

rows.note: Equities +$19.9B domestic and +$6.6B world, after a brief -$2.5B equity dip the prior week.
Record $7.95T in the week of 1 Jul, up $47.7B that week, then eased $22.6B by the week of 22 Jul. Still elevated cash parking.
North America led the outflow. First-half net inflows cut to +$8B. GLD alone bounced +$557M on 24 Jul, a US-specific stabilisation inside a weak global picture.
Smallest monthly net inflow on that print. A 10-day $2.73B outflow streak, then a 3-day $510M inflow burst early in the month.
Outpaced bitcoin ETFs for the month on this snapshot.

sources: August 2026 research board, reported net flows through late July. Complements the later Signal flow card. Do not blend the two prints.
